description:
Bring the stack up and install `modules` into `service`'s database (creates the db on first
    run). Include `website` for the public site; for an EE service add `web_enterprise` (flips the
    UI to Enterprise). On an Enterprise database it then installs the Enterprise auto-install
    modules a database created as Enterprise would have (Odoo skips those whose dependencies were
    already installed - e.g. after starting as Community): crm_enterprise, ai_auto_install → ai →
    ai_mcp on 20, ... and reports whether the db has pgvector (AI needs it). dry_run shows the
    script.
name: docker_db_init
